references.text: The agreement between Isaac and Abimelech, which is also a covenant between two parties, resembles the agreement between Jacob and Laban.
The agreement between Abraham and Abimelech at Beersheba, serving as an early example of a covenant between individuals.
The covenant between Jacob and Laban, where they set up a mound as a witness to their agreement, directly linked to the establishment of the covenant.
A parallel event where a covenant is made between two parties to confirm God's presence and ensure peace.
A direct parallel where God serves as the supreme witness between two parties to confirm a covenant obligation.
